resources.string: Shared on-device AI models for your apps
Android did not let OndolSaem stay running in the background, so models set to “keep loaded” may be unloaded. Tap to open OndolSaem and try again.

Android refused to keep OndolSaem running in the background, so models set to “keep loaded” may be unloaded when no app is using them. Opening OndolSaem fixes it until the next time. Turning off battery optimization for OndolSaem lets it start in the background too.
Turns text, images and audio into vectors so apps can search by meaning. Apps store these vectors: changing the model means they must re-create their data.
Answers questions, summarises and calls app tools. The largest models: 1.5–4 GB on disk and in memory.
Reads text in photos and scanned pages.
Turns speech in voice recordings and videos into text. Finding the parts that contain speech works without a download.
The device is low on memory: models that are not set to stay loaded are unloaded first.
Context length (tokens; longer chats need more memory)
Selected, but not downloaded yet: apps cannot use this category until it is.
Access denied. Add a Hugging Face token in Settings and accept the model license on huggingface.co.
Model file not found on Hugging Face.
Network error. Retry to resume the download.
Multimodal (text + image) embeddings, 768 dims. Recommended default.
Larger multimodal model that also supports audio.
Google\'s multimodal chat model (text and images), about 2 B effective parameters. Recommended default.
Larger and more capable than E2B (text and images). Needs more memory.
Smaller text-only chat model; faster on weak phones, weaker at using tools.
Google\'s system-managed on-device model via Android AICore (text and images, ~1.1–1.5 GB system RAM, up to 4K tokens). Available on supported Pixel and flagship devices.
Not supported on this device (requires Android AICore)
Google ML Kit text recognition for Korean and Latin scripts. Runs offline.
PaddleOCR mobile model for Korean text.
Finds faces in photos and turns each into a vector so apps can group photos by person. Apps store these vectors: changing the model means they must scan the faces again.
Detects faces on the phone (ML Kit, built in) and recognizes them with SFace (OpenCV Zoo, 128 dims).
Recognises Korean, English, Chinese and Japanese speech offline.
Very small speech recognition model, one language per model.
You are on mobile data or a metered Wi-Fi. %1$s is %2$s.

Vectors from different models cannot be compared. Apps that use this category must re-create all their data with %1$s (for example, Nunsori indexes all files again), which takes a while and uses the battery.\n\nApps that use it: %2$s
Text that apps derived with the old model may differ from what %1$s produces; they may redo that work.\n\nApps that use it: %2$s
No app has used OndolSaem yet.
Apps listed here are notified when a model they use changes. Request counts start over when OndolSaem restarts.
Only needed for models whose license must be accepted on huggingface.co. Stored on this device and sent only to huggingface.co.
OndolSaem keeps on-device AI models for other apps. Models run on this phone; nothing you search, say or show is sent anywhere.
The downloaded file was damaged and has been deleted. Retry to download it again.
It is not one of your own apps. Tap to allow or deny its access to your AI models.
Waiting for your decision. It can use the models only after you allow it; it then sends its inputs (text, images, audio) to OndolSaem, which runs them on this phone.
OndolSaem keeps on-device AI models for your other apps, such as Nunsori.
A model is downloaded and loaded once, and every app that needs it shares it.
Everything runs on this phone. Your photos, recordings and texts never leave it.
Only your own apps can use it; other apps have to ask you first.
These apps already use OndolSaem, for:
No app has connected yet. Apps that use OndolSaem show up here and in the Apps tab.
One model per kind of task. Ticked are the ones your apps need. You can change them later in the Models tab.
Downloads continue in the background; Wi-Fi is recommended. You can also skip this and download later.
OndolSaem shows download progress, and a notification while models are kept in memory (Android needs it to keep them loaded). It also tells you when an app asks to use it.

Answers yes or no with a confidence: whether a text matches a topic or a condition. Apps use it to tag notes or to check new files for scheduled tasks. Apps notice a new model and check again on their own.
Generates 768×768 images from detailed text descriptions. Single-turn high-memory task: unloads immediately after creation.
LiquidAI decision model that also reads images and audio. Planned; Korean is not among its languages yet.
LiquidAI d1-Omni 2B multimodal decision model with official Korean and vision support. Downloads 3.9 GB and converts weights on the phone to about 1.95 GB.
Qwen3.5 2B multimodal chat model with vision (reads images).
LiquidAI LFM3 2B multimodal chat model with vision (reads images).
LiquidAI LFM3 Omni 2B multimodal chat model supporting text, images, and audio.
Iris 3B Turbo fast 4-step distilled image generation model (768×768 px). Downloads 11.3 GB and converts the text encoder and embedding table on the phone to about 7.2 GB.
Multilingual natural language inference (trained on Korean too), text only. Downloads the original model (1.1 GB) and converts it on the phone to about 325 MB. About 40 ms per question.
The same model, ready-made 4-bit build: no conversion, but about 845 MB on disk and about 800 MB of memory while loaded.
This phone\'s chip has no NPU that OndolSaem can use (NPU builds are made for Snapdragon, Dimensity and Google Tensor chips, on Android 12 or newer), so models run on the GPU.
Models with a downloaded NPU build run on the NPU (faster, cooler). If the NPU fails, they run on the GPU, then the CPU. Download NPU builds under each model in Models.

Qualcomm NPUs need Qualcomm\'s runtime, which is downloaded with the first NPU build from Maven Central (75 MB download; only the Hexagon %1$s libraries, about 25 MB, are kept). It is covered by Qualcomm\'s license; it is deleted with the last NPU build.
Installed: used instead of the GPU
Installed (NPU use is off in Settings)
No NPU build of this model for %1$s yet: it runs on the GPU
OndolSaem does not know this Snapdragon chip\'s NPU (Hexagon) version yet, so its NPU cannot be used. Models run on the GPU.
For %1$s: %2$s. Download them under each model in Models.
No NPU builds of OndolSaem\'s models are published for %1$s yet. Checked again weekly while the app is used.
Could not check (offline?). The last result is kept.
Loads each downloaded NPU build on the CPU, GPU and NPU in turn, compares their results and speed, and writes a report to copy or share (takes a few minutes; models in use are not interrupted).
